run_musicgen_eval: run objective metric evaluation on a pretrained MusicGen model using a Dora launcher with configurable batch size
run_chroma_eval: run chroma cosine similarity evaluation on a MusicGen melody model with 30-second audio segments
run_musicgen_small_eval: run evaluation on the pretrained MusicGen small model with top-k sampling and two-step CFG
run_musicgen_melody_eval: run evaluation on the pretrained MusicGen melody model with chroma-specific metrics enabled
run_musicgen_grid: run the full evaluation grid across MusicGen small, medium, large, and melody models via SLURM job array
